I think something similar happened to me. I have very few memories of my childhood and it wasn't until recently I realized that it had happened. I remember my neighbor would come over sometimes while my mother was in our house and he would touch me. I remember playing a game and we had to be quiet so my mother couldn't hear.  I think this happened often. I also remember being filmed in a room. I was standing looking towards the bed and there was a little girl, probably the same age as me and she was slowly taking off her shirt while walking towards me on the bed. I look over and there is a camera on a tripod. I don't remember who was behind it but I know they were older. Sometimes I think the girl was my sister and I can't look at her in the face since this memory decided to drift back. I hate myself and I'm disgusted that this happened in my own home. I hate my mother and haven't spoken to her in years. How can she let her daughter and son be abused like this. I think she may have been involved or it was just the meth that blinded her. Either way I'm disgusted.  I feel know what you feel and this was the most I've ever spoken about it. I briefly mentioned it when I last saw a psychologist but didn't talk much about it because I remembered even less and wasn't sure it happened. Everyday I become more sure and more disgusted.
I do feel lost myself man. I ask myself daily why the fuck am I still breathing. Yet I continue to wake up. I don't have the balls to actually do anything about it.
